name: remote-job-monitor
description: Security-hardened tracked routing for local, SSH, and GitHub jobs with OS-managed credentials and a token-free dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Default tracked route for SSH, remote jobs, and publishing.
interface.longDescription: Automatically prefers one trace-bound RunBeacon job for non-interactive remote execution. A protocol-v4 resident daemon cannot be downgraded by older Codex tasks. Independent default SSH and GitHub profiles remove repeated credential selection while preserving explicit overrides. The live dashboard shows prompt, credential, queue, SSH, command, and total timing, and its direct default-SSH launcher bypasses model scheduling for exact commands. RE2-compatible progress parsing, bounded waits, and OS-managed SSH/GitHub credentials preserve the security boundary without repeated model turns.
defaultPrompt: Run this command on my default SSH server through RunBeacon, show the live dashboard, and continue when it finishes.
Save this SSH server IP, username, and password in the OS credential manager and make it my default.
Push my staged commit and monitor GitHub Actions in the dashboard.
